comment: Rolling flake rate per test id, rebuilt by .github/workflows/flake-ledger.yml from the flake-records-* artifacts of recent CI runs. `rate` is hits (flaked + failed + quarantined) over runsInWindow. Do not hand-edit: regenerate with `node .github/scripts/flake-ledger.mjs ledger --records <dir> --window-runs N`. See docs/ci-flakes.md.
